programs.title: NC Medicaid
programs.rationale: The questions the DHB-5200 health-coverage application itself asks, as reviewed in the full-form mapping round (kb/forms/dhb-5200.json): who is applying and for what coverage, household composition, income with its conditional branches, shelter and cost expenses, photo ID, date of birth, citizenship/immigration status, disability, veteran status, and how mail and messages reach the person. Deliberately left out: goal_detail (a free-text navigation note the application has no field for), student_status and received_benefits_before (the printed form does not ask them) — the talk stage still covers every spec question the quick-questions stage does not capture.
